sentences.zh: 一个非常重要的原因是误判。

sentences.en: This idea that their intelligence led them to target something that they believed to be ISIS.

sentences.zh: 真正了解平民是否在场，或者影像的质量很低。

sentences.en: One case that just really stood out to me was this November 2015 airstrike in Ramadi, where they were watching what they had assessed to be a defensive fighting position.
sentences.zh: 有一个案例让我记忆犹新，那是2015年11月在拉马迪的一次空袭，当时他们在监视一个他们评估为防御性战斗阵地的目标。

sentences.en: And they saw a man drag a, quote, unknown heavy object into that building.
sentences.zh: 他们看到一个男人将一个引述“未知的重物”拖进那栋建筑。

sentences.en: They carried out an airstrike against that building.
sentences.zh: 他们对那栋建筑实施了空袭。

sentences.en: And only later did someone looking at the footage on a bigger screen TV identify that that unknown object wasn't an object.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，有人在更大屏幕的电视上观看画面时才发现，那个未知的物体根本不是物体。

sentences.en: It was a person.
sentences.zh: 而是一个人。

sentences.en: And the way they characterized it was a person of small stature, consistent with how a child would appear standing next to an adult.
sentences.zh: 他们对其特征的描述是一个身材矮小的人，这符合儿童站在成年人身旁时的外表。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So that object was a child.
sentences.zh: 所以那个物体是一个孩子。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So part of what you're finding is that the most advanced military in the world is basing decisions to launch airstrikes on what seems like some pretty crappy quality video.
sentences.zh: 因此，你发现的情况之一是，世界上最先进的军队，其发动空袭的决策居然基于看起来质量相当粗糙的视频。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's not always the case that they have that high quality video.
sentences.zh: 他们并不总是能获得那种高画质的视频。

sentences.en: Sometimes it was pretty poor.
sentences.zh: 有时画质相当差。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what was another pattern that you saw in these assessments?
sentences.zh: 那么，你在这些评估中看到的另一个模式是什么？

sentences.en: So another category was just rushing to carry out these strikes.
sentences.zh: 所以另一个类别就是匆忙执行这些空袭。

sentences.en: So as an example, you know, sometimes they would prep targets in advance and they would look for targets and then put them
sentences.zh: 举个例子，你知道，有时他们会提前准备目标，寻找目标然后把它们

sentences.en: aside, like basically wait to carry them out until a more strategically opportune moment.
sentences.zh: 搁置一边，基本上就是等到战略上更恰当的时机再执行。

sentences.en: But when they finally do carry out those strikes later, their intel is out of date and inaccurate.
sentences.zh: 但当他们后来终于执行这些空袭时，他们的情报已经过时且不准确了。

sentences.en: You know, before an offensive to retake a part of Syria known as Tabqa, they pulled up these
sentences.zh: 你知道，在一次旨在夺回叙利亚一个被称为塔布卡（Tabqa）的地区的攻势之前，他们调出了这些

sentences.en: previously vetted targets and they greenlit them in rapid succession without really re-evaluating
sentences.zh: 先前经过审查的目标，并在没有真正重新评估的情况下迅速连续批准了它们

sentences.en: whether, you know, these targets, which were based on months old intelligence, were now functioning in some other manner, for example, were now being used by civilians.
sentences.zh: 这些基于几个月前情报的目标，是否现在正以某种其他方式运作，例如，现在是否被平民使用。

sentences.en: So in the case of those
sentences.zh: 所以在这些案例中

sentences.en: Tabqa strikes, they concluded that there were all of these different problems with the intelligence and that as a result, you know, they believed 10 civilians had been killed.
sentences.zh: 塔布卡空袭事件中，他们得出结论认为情报存在所有这些不同的问题，因此，他们认为有 10 名平民丧生。

sentences.en: You had mentioned that these assessments serve two purposes, to review an incident, but also to provide some framework for the military holding itself accountable.
sentences.zh: 你曾提到这些评估有两个目的，一是审查事件，二是为军方追究自身责任提供某种框架。

sentences.en: Did you find any evidence that there were repercussions for the incidents that you just described and for the people who carried them out?
sentences.zh: 你有没有发现任何证据表明，你刚刚描述的事件以及执行这些事件的人受到了惩罚？

sentences.en: So in not one of these 1,300 assessments was there a finding of wrongdoing or of disciplinary action for the particular people involved in carrying it out.
sentences.zh: 在这 1,300 份评估中，没有一份得出存在不当行为或对具体涉事人员采取纪律处分的结论。

sentences.en: But not only that, they weren't really doing what I was doing, which was to look at all of these assessments in aggregate, to study them,
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他们实际上并没有做我一直在做的事情，那就是综合查看所有这些评估，进行研究，

sentences.en: to try to find patterns, lessons, recommendations in totality, you know, basically an effort to prevent these recurring problems from happening again and again.
sentences.zh: 试图全面找出模式、教训和建议，你知道的，这基本上是一项旨在防止这些反复出现的问题一再发生的努力。

sentences.en: And also, what did the U.S.
sentences.zh: 还有，美国

sentences.en: military say when, after all this review of these documents,
sentences.zh: 在经过对这些文件的所有审查之后，军方怎么说，

sentences.en: you brought them your reporting and basically told them what was in their own assessments about civilian deaths?
sentences.zh: 当你把你的报道拿给他们，基本上把他们自己的评估中关于平民伤亡的内容告诉他们时？

sentences.en: The military told me that they regret each loss of civilian life and that they work diligently to avoid this kind of harm.
sentences.zh: 军方告诉我，他们对每一条平民生命的丧失感到遗憾，并一直在努力避免这种伤害。

sentences.en: But I didn't see that level of commitment in the documents.
sentences.zh: 但我没有在文件中看到这种程度的承诺。

sentences.en: And I definitely didn't see it when I investigated these cases on the ground.
sentences.zh: 当我实地调查这些案件时，我绝对没有看到这一点。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，并获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So describe this reporting that you do on the ground that is raising so many questions about whether the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，请描述一下你在实地所做的报道，这些报道引发了如此多的质疑，即美国

sentences.en: really is committed to preventing civilian deaths.
sentences.zh: 是否真的致力于防止平民伤亡。

sentences.en: So it's always been important for me to investigate these types of incidents on the ground.
sentences.zh: 因此，对我来说，实地调查这类事件一直很重要。

sentences.en: But in this case especially, because I have all of these documents with details about how the military determined that this was a valid target
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下尤其如此，因为我拥有所有这些文件，其中详细说明了军方如何确定这是一个合法目标

sentences.en: and what they believe went wrong, I have the opportunity to actually assess the assessments, to get a truer accounting of what went wrong and why.
sentences.zh: 以及他们认为哪里出了问题，我有机会真正评估这些评估，从而更真实地弄清哪里出了问题以及原因何在。

sentences.en: So over the course of years, I visited more than 100 civilian casualty strike sites in Iraq, Syria, and Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 因此，多年来，我走访了伊拉克、叙利亚和阿富汗的 100 多个平民伤亡空袭现场。

sentences.en: And for those credible cases, right, where I have these documents, I had to have a very rigorous methodology to match that incident to the document to make sure the place I'm in
sentences.zh: 对于那些有据可查的可靠案件，我必须采用非常严密的方，将该事件与文件进行匹配，以确保我所在的地点

sentences.en: actually corresponds to the incident being described in the military's assessment.
sentences.zh: 确实与军方评估中所描述的事件相符。

sentences.en: So, you know, I would arrive at the coordinate where the strike allegedly took place.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我会到达据称发生空袭的坐标处。

sentences.en: And sometimes I would walk into a corner store or a local market and ask if there were any airstrikes in that area.
sentences.zh: 有时我会走进一家街角小店或当地市场，询问该地区是否有过空袭。

sentences.en: What happened in that event?
sentences.zh: 当时发生了什么？

sentences.en: Sometimes I would knock on a door.
sentences.zh: 有时我会敲门。

sentences.en: You can just tell him we're journalists and we heard about what happened to your daughter and we're trying to understand that and document what happened to this incident.
sentences.zh: 你可以直接告诉他们我们是记者，我们听说了你女儿身上发生的事情，我们正试图理解并记录这起事件的经过。

sentences.en: And go precisely if it was a house where it took place.
sentences.zh: 如果是发生在一所房子里，就直接去那里。

sentences.en: What was the airstrike targeting?
sentences.zh: 空袭的目标是什么？

sentences.en: What was it?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: What did it hit?
sentences.zh: 它击中了什么？

sentences.en: You know, I would ask someone in that house, you know, was there an airstrike here?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我会问那里的某个人，这里发生过空袭吗？

sentences.en: So that house fell on this house.
sentences.zh: 所以那栋房子倒塌在这栋房子上。

sentences.en: And I had to be really careful not to lead with information that other people might just agree to or say they remembered to really vet and verify that.
sentences.zh: 我必须非常小心，不要带有引导性信息，以免其他人只是随声附和或者说他们记得，从而真正进行审查和核实。

sentences.en: Because sometimes people might feel incentivized to just confirm what you're asking about, to say that they saw something because you're a foreign journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 因为有时人们可能会有动机去证实你的询问，说他们看到了什么，因为你是一名外国记者。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's sometimes a perception that aid can come their way or that talking to you or saying that they're a survivor of an airstrike may result in a payment.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有时人们会觉得可能会因此得到援助，或者与你交谈、声称自己是空袭幸存者可能会带来一笔赔偿金。

sentences.en: I'm so sorry for your loss.
sentences.zh: 对于您的遭遇我深表遗憾。

sentences.en: So I can only report out what happened.
sentences.zh: 所以我只能报道真实发生的事情。

sentences.en: Sometimes people are just confused.
sentences.zh: 有时人们只是感到困惑。

sentences.en: So you want to be able to seek out the most reliable information and you want to interview the people, the sources,
sentences.zh: 所以你希望能够寻找最可靠的信息，并且你想采访那些人、那些消息来源，

sentences.en: with the best eyewitness testimony, with the best direct experience.
sentences.zh: 拥有最好的目击证词，拥有最好的直接经验。

sentences.en: And did these people you spoke with have any theories about why they had been targeted?
sentences.zh: 你交谈过的这些人对他们为什么成为目标有什么看法吗？

sentences.en: I mean, sometimes people were completely confused as to why an airstrike hit that location.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有时人们完全搞不懂为什么空袭会击中那个地方。

sentences.en: You know, they didn't see an ISIS target nearby and they were really struggling to comprehend that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们在附近没有看到任何极端组织“伊斯兰国”的目标，他们对此感到非常难以理解。

sentences.en: Sometimes they understood, you know, that there had been an ISIS member nearby.
sentences.zh: 有时他们知道，附近确实有“伊斯兰国”成员。

sentences.en: Most of the time people really just wanted someone to listen to their stories, to hear what they'd suffered, what they'd experienced,
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，人们其实只是想找个人倾听他们的故事，听听他们所遭受的苦难，他们的经历，

sentences.en: what it meant to lose someone they loved or to be permanently disabled.
sentences.zh: 失去挚爱或终身残疾意味着什么。

sentences.en: And I think the one incident I remember most is an interview in West Mosul.
sentences.zh: 我想我记忆最深刻的一个事件是西摩苏尔的一次采访。

sentences.en: So I had this document that described an ISIS bed-down location, this place where ISIS fighters were apparently sleeping, in this village known as Al-Tanak.
sentences.zh: 我当时有这样一份文件，描述了一个“伊斯兰国”的藏身点，也就是“伊斯兰国”武装分子显然在睡觉的地方，位于阿尔塔纳克（Al-Tanak）这个村庄。

sentences.en: And in the document, they describe, you know, having determined that this was exclusively used by ISIS.
sentences.zh: 文件里描述说，他们已经确定这里完全是由“伊斯兰国”使用的。

sentences.en: And before carrying out the strike, they were observing this house exclusively used by ISIS.
sentences.zh: 在发动空袭之前，他们一直在监视这个完全由“伊斯兰国”使用的房子。

sentences.en: And then they see something they don't expect.
sentences.zh: 然后他们看到了意想不到的事情。

sentences.en: Three children on the roof.
sentences.zh: 屋顶上有三个孩子。

sentences.en: Now this directly challenges their assessment that this was exclusively used by ISIS.
sentences.zh: 这直接对他们关于这里完全由“伊斯兰国”使用的评估提出了挑战。

sentences.en: So they return this targeting package back to the team to reassess it.
sentences.zh: 于是他们把这个目标方案交回团队重新评估。

sentences.en: And they look at it, and they now up the numbers, you know, their estimate of how many civilian casualties there will be.
sentences.zh: 他们看了一下，然后提高了数字，也就是他们对平民伤亡人数的估计。

sentences.en: And they say three people might die.
sentences.zh: 他们说可能会有三个人死亡。

sentences.en: And they go back and they look at this target, and now they don't just see it as a place where ISIS fighters sleep, they see it as a weapons manufacturing facility.
sentences.zh: 然后他们回去重新审视这个目标，现在他们不再仅仅认为这里是“伊斯兰国”武装分子睡觉的地方，而是将其视为一个武器制造厂。

sentences.en: And it's because of something that is redacted coming from the target.
sentences.zh: 这是因为来自目标的某个经过编辑涂黑的信息。

sentences.en: Now, I don't know what that is.
sentences.zh: 现在，我不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: But I really wanted to understand what made them so confident to wind up targeting that facility after having seen three children.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很想弄明白，在看到三个孩子之后，是什么让他们如此自信，最终还是要对该设施实施打击。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I go to this site.
sentences.zh: 所以我去了这个现场。

sentences.en: And I ask around, and people very quickly identify this as the location of where the strike happened.
sentences.zh: 我四处打听，人们很快就认出这里是空袭发生的地.

sentences.en: And people tell me that there was a family, all of whom were killed except for one little girl who survived.
sentences.zh: 人们告诉我，这里曾有一个家庭，除了一个幸存的小女孩外，全家遇难。

sentences.en: And that next door, a few people were injured, including another little girl who was permanently disabled.
sentences.zh: 隔壁有几个人受伤，其中包括另一个终身残疾的小女孩。

sentences.en: And after talking to that family with those injuries,
sentences.zh: 在与那个有伤员的家庭交谈之后，

sentences.en: I ask about the one little girl who survived from the family in the home that was targeted.
sentences.zh: 我询问了那个在遭到袭击的房屋中幸存的小女孩的情况。

sentences.en: And they told me that she's now living with her grandmother.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我她现在和祖母住在一起。

sentences.en: And eventually, I get to that grandmother's house, a woman named Qatbaya Ahmed.
sentences.zh: 最终，我找到了那个祖母的家，一个名叫卡塔尔巴娅·艾哈迈德（Qatbaya Ahmed）的女人。

sentences.en: It's OK.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: I'm OK.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: I'm OK.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: I'm not OK.
sentences.zh: 我不好。

sentences.en: Shukran.
sentences.zh: 舒克兰。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And she just invites me and my translator, Momin, in.
sentences.zh: 她只是邀请我和我的译者莫明（Momin）进去。

sentences.en: She's really warm and inviting.
sentences.zh: 她非常热情好客。

sentences.en: First of all, I'm, you know, I'm a journalist, and I'm trying to understand...
sentences.zh: 首先，我，你知道，我是一名记者，我正试图了解……

sentences.en: And, you know, I started the interview in the way that I normally do, just telling her that I was a journalist, trying to understand what happened in incidents that harm civilians.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我像往常一样开始了采访，只是告诉她我是一名记者，试图了解伤害平民的事件中究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: And I want to ask you some questions about it, but if anything I'm asking is hurting you or it's difficult for children to hear, I don't have to ask.
sentences.zh: 我想就此问你一些问题，但如果我问的任何事情伤害了你，或者对孩子们来说很难听，我可以不问。

sentences.en: And you're welcome to say, no, I don't want to answer that at any time.
sentences.zh: 你随时都可以说，不，我不想回答那个问题。

sentences.en: And she smiled and she said, ask whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 她微笑着说，你想问什么就问吧。

sentences.en: So we had a conversation where she told me about her brother, whose house this was, and how her brother's son was married to her daughter.
sentences.zh: 于是我们进行了一次谈话，她向我讲述了她的兄弟——也就是这所房子的主人，以及她兄弟的儿子如何娶了她的女儿。

sentences.en: And so she lost more than just her brother.
sentences.zh: 所以她失去的不仅仅是她的兄弟。

sentences.en: She lost her daughter, who was her best friend.
sentences.zh: 她失去了她的女儿，也就是她最好的朋友。

sentences.en: She was my life.
sentences.zh: 她就是我的命。

sentences.en: She was my oldest daughter.
sentences.zh: 她是我最大的女儿。

sentences.en: She was not only my daughter.
sentences.zh: 她不仅仅是我的女儿。

sentences.en: She was my friend and my everything.
sentences.zh: 她还是我的朋友和我的一切。

sentences.en: She'd lost grandchildren and nephews and nieces.
sentences.zh: 她失去了孙辈、侄子和侄女。

sentences.en: And that after the bombing, neighbors heard what they thought was the sound of a cat screaming.
sentences.zh: 轰炸过后，邻居们听到了他们认为是猫叫声的声音。

sentences.en: And when they lifted the blocks, they found Rahaf, the one little girl who survived.
sentences.zh: 当他们搬开水泥块时，他们找到了拉哈夫（Rahaf），那个幸存的小女孩。

sentences.en: She told me that she'd taken in her granddaughter.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我她收养了自己的孙女。

sentences.en: So I told her,
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉她，

sentences.en: I told Rahaf,
sentences.zh: 我告诉拉哈夫，

sentences.en: I am your mom.
sentences.zh: 我是你的妈妈。

sentences.en: I just wanted to let her know that because I have other daughters, so she was just like my other daughters.
sentences.zh: 我只是想让她知道这一点，因为我还有其他女儿，所以她就像我的其他女儿一样。

sentences.en: So I was as a mom for her.
sentences.zh: 所以我对她就像母亲一样。

sentences.en: And I still am.
sentences.zh: 现在依然如此。

sentences.en: She calls me mom and she calls Saddam dad.
sentences.zh: 她叫我妈妈，叫萨达姆（Saddam）爸爸。

sentences.en: She told me that the family was poor, that they had been planning to come to her house for a meal that night because they often could barely afford to eat.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，这个家庭很穷，他们那天晚上本来计划去她家吃饭，因为他们经常几乎吃不起饭。

sentences.en: And she said,
sentences.zh: 她说，

sentences.en: I'll never forget this.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记这一点。

sentences.en: At that day, they didn't even have dinner.
sentences.zh: 那天，他们甚至没有吃晚饭。

sentences.en: They died without eating.
